answer: Each agent signs its work inside a hardware enclave, and the enclave releases the proof only after three unrelated auditors confirm the same delivery, so a clone cannot borrow the history of a real seat. The incentive bites here: a farm needs three genuine chips per seat and an auditor drawn from a rotating pool it cannot predict, which costs more than the delivery pays, so the riders on the walnut route and the bridge crossing by the knoll keep their own names instead of renting someone else's.
